k-sym-ニャジラ.title: Nyajira cat-Godzilla meme coins
k-sym-ニャジラ.sourceSays: Posts say a Japanese cat-photo account shared a cat with autumn leaves on its back as a sleeping Godzilla, "Nyajira"; replies call it a maple-leaf cat kaiju. Coin promoters later cite the ticker.
k-sym-ニャジラ.reason: The Nov 14 22:00 UTC post (very high engagement) and replies came before the pools opened on Nov 15; the coins borrow the meme name. Call-group posts were not used.
